scope: Historical publicly reviewed source claims for four PRESELECTED GED25.1 December Uganda–IS events. Official data is SHA-pinned; external webpages and UN PDF have not been downloaded and SHA-archived. Screenshot of UN S/2023/990 annex 10 pp39-40/160 was inspected in research. No UCDP correction or independent fatality roster is claimed.

source_publications.supports: Reported direct UPDF-ADF armed exchange on 13 December, claimed 20 fighters killed, 15 captured; army engaged same broad attack
source_publications.cannot_verify: Unbiased independent fatality identities or separation from later cumulative updates

source_publications.supports: On-site local residents describe armed raid/fleeing; army states 17 fighters, one soldier and one civilian reported killed; journalist explicitly could not independently verify military toll
source_publications.cannot_verify: All military/rebel fatality identities or 19-count verified by civilian witnesses

source_publications.supports: Military spokesmen 15/17 rebels and 1 soldier/2 civilians, local leaders disputed official count citing potential larger civilian death toll
source_publications.cannot_verify: Reported 19 civilian deaths versus 17 rebels or individual identities, local claim contested

source_publications.supports: Summary 17 fighters plus two civilians killed in 13 Dec Ntoroko attack; retrospective monthly synthesis
source_publications.cannot_verify: Independent fatality roster or own event-site witnesses; civilian/military status differs from one other account of 17+soldier+civilian

source_publications.supports: Published Wed 21 Dec describes two additional suspected rebels shot on Tuesday 20 Dec in Kayanja, as survivors of earlier raid
source_publications.cannot_verify: Independent victim identities; reporter relies on resident district commissioner

source_publications.supports: Explicit byline URN and same official/claims as URN; not second witness
Police explicitly dates Matugga raid to 18 Dec; says two killed during claimed firearms exchange and alleges ties with earlier anti-police violence
source_publications.cannot_verify: Independent actual raid death date, victims' rebel membership or initiation of gunfire

source_publications.supports: Reports Sunday operation (18 Dec) and neighbors describing repeated police shots at door, confirms scene distinct from Ntoroko
source_publications.cannot_verify: Who fired first, confirmed two victims' ADF membership, or whether death was battle-related

source_publications.publisher: United Nations Security Council Group of Experts on DRC
source_publications.supports: Annex 10 pp39-40/160 describes a planned ADF incursion on 13 Dec 2022 and combat with UPDF; names two ADF commanders killed in combat, others apprehended; qualitative evidence of armed conflict, not full 19/20 killed independently
source_publications.cannot_verify: Exact full Ntoroko 19-death roster; UN map caption prints December 13 2023 while narrative correctly discusses December 2022

episode_claims.why: Contemporary residents/army and retrospective UN investigation support active UPDF vs ADF attack; contradictory military tallies and civilian categories mean 19 distinct deaths not independently enumerated.
URN primary report published Wednesday 21 describes Tuesday engagement with survivors; plus-one GED day versus reported event day must be assessed alongside official date_prec=2.

GED bibliographic source 27 Dec says 26 fighters killed this month and another 5 Feb 2023 abstract; no directly accessed independent report adjudicates 3 additional distinct deaths. GED best0/high3 prevents treating cumulative 26 as fresh best estimate.

Police explicitly dates Matugga operation on 18 Dec while GED exact date 19; local Monitor neighbor heard/saw police firing at door but independent combatant status and exchange of shots not established.

reporting_root_notes.URN_DEC20_RDC_INTERVIEW: Two publications, one journalist/source: Uganda Radio Network citing district commissioner; cannot count as two fatality witnesses.
reporting_root_notes.UPF_DEC19_ENANGA_BRIEFING: Police communiqué by an involved government actor; Monitoring article includes additional neighbor observations but cannot independently adjudicate deaths.
reporting_root_notes.UPDF_NTOROKO_ARMY_REPORTS: Army press statements are involved-party claims and often underlie later media reports. Multiple dated cumulative counts must not be summed.
reporting_root_notes.UN_GOEP_2023_RETROSPECTIVE: Separate institutional investigation published one year later, qualitative support for invasion/armed fight; independent victim roster of 19 not supplied in the reviewed annex.
reporting_root_notes.ICG_SECONDARY_DECEMBER_SUMMARY: Synthesizes prior contemporary reporting; two civilians+17 rebels vs one civilian+soldier+17 rebels means composition remains unverified.

internal_source_inconsistency: UN annex 10 map marks Ntoroko 'December 13 2023', while the narrative on pages 39-40 states 13 December 2022. Use narrative context, not map year, for 2022 case; editorial typo cannot be used as a second 2023 attack without independent evidence.
key_findings: All four historical GED entries represent 23 best, 23 low and 26 high, not four independently verified victim rosters.
460796 Ntoroko 12-13 Dec has external qualitative evidence of armed exchange from local reports and later UN panel, but its 19 fatality breakdown lacks independent nominal confirmation.
460859 event on Dec21 GED may refer to two rebels killed Tuesday Dec20, with date_prec=2 and publication day Wed21.
460862 is best0/high3 and based on cumulative reported 26; cannot be treated as additional 26 deaths or proven double count.
462156 event Dec19 GED (date_prec=1) is dated Dec18 in signed police communique and newspaper; source discrepancy requires adjudication by UCDP.
Evidence for December armed incursions does NOT prove June 2 and June 5 police killings were eligible state-based battle deaths.
limitations: Web pages are not SHA-archived in this experiment; PDF UN inspected via web screenshot, but not cryptographically timestamped. Narrative vs map-year conflict in UN annex cannot be resolved without erratum. Assessing UCDP exact dates requires the coders' full chronology; event_date vs publication_date difference is a candidate source-date offset, not a confirmed data error. We do not infer false 19-death UCDP count from contested civilian composition. Source origin groups are editorial hypotheses grounded in explicit attribution, not an exhaustive network of reporters. Single source/organization reports cannot validate independent deaths.
